record: Sponsored H.R. 7151, the AI Public Awareness and Education Campaign Act, with Rep. Obernolte (public information campaign on AI).
Introduced the HEAL-AI Act, grants for AI literacy training in medical schools.
Co-sponsored H.R. 8031 to repeal the executive order 'Ensuring a National Policy Framework for Artificial Intelligence' and H.R. 9183 on environmental impacts of AI.
grade_reason: She has spoken about AI in 2025 and 2026 (consumer awareness, AI in medical education) but no statement found acknowledges catastrophic risk from AI.
notes: Seven web searches ran, none refused. Searches on superintelligence, extinction, pause, China agreement and AI safety returned nothing about her. The Congressional Record Index 2026 entry for her (as summarized by the page fetch tool) does not list the Ban Artificial Superintelligence Act (H.R. 10538); public reports name only some of its House co-sponsors and do not mention her, but congress.gov was not checked, so co-sponsorship cannot be fully ruled out. Multi-signer House letters were not searched, per instructions. The govinfo index and H.R. 8031/9183 details were read via a summarizing fetch, not verbatim.
